description: This file implements a Windows-specific address sorting class for network endpoints, utilizing Windows Sockets API and asynchronous task execution to sort IP addresses.

classes.name: AddressSorterWin
classes.description: A Windows-specific implementation of AddressSorter that sorts IP addresses asynchronously using Windows Sockets API.

classes.name: AddressSorterWin::Job
classes.description: A helper class that performs the address sorting operation asynchronously in a thread pool.

methods.name: Sort
methods.description: Sorts a list of IP endpoints asynchronously.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Static method to initiate the address sorting job asynchronously.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Performs the address list sorting using WSAIoctl.

methods.name: OnComplete
methods.description: Callback after sorting completes, processes sorted addresses.
